name: On-chain breadth confirms a fast breakout — active-address cross-up + short-horizon momentum quick long
rationale: Thesis: a SHORT-horizon momentum kick (3-7d) that is simultaneously confirmed by a breadth surge in active addresses is a high-conviction, short-hold continuation trade — fresh participants arriving as price accelerates. This is the fast-twitch sibling of the slow hashrate variant: tight stop, short time-stop, ride the impulse a few days. btc_active_addresses drifts so it enters ONLY as a cross_up; the momentum leg uses a short lookback. Disconfirmer 1: replace the active-address cross_up with a permuted-lag copy of the same series — if the deflated Sharpe is unchanged, the cross timing is information-free and only the momentum kick matters. Disconfirmer 2: lengthen the momentum lookback to 20-30d (slow trend) — if that absorbs all the Sharpe, the 'fast breakout' framing is illusory and this is just slow momentum. BTC/ETH/SOL, long-only spot.
catalyst: btc_active_addresses crosses up while a short-horizon (3-7d) momentum kick fires
